chunks: And those who disbelieve Our revelations shall be cast into Hell; and when their skin is burnt up and singed, We shall give them a new coat that they may go on tasting the agony of punishment, for God is all-mighty and all-wise.
ai.seo_question: How does the Quran describe the continuous nature of punishment in Hell for disbelievers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (4:56) is often linked to the concept of *Tajdid al-'Adhāb* (renewal of punishment), illustrating that the physical regeneration of skin ensures the intensity of pain remains constant, reflecting divine justice rather than mere retribution. It underscores the attribute of *Al-Hakīm* (The Wise) in tailoring punishment to the specific nature of the disbelievers' rejection of clear signs.
